cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# Local review results

The prepared change makes the existing `full` implementation the default.
The historical default at `d458a98` was `baseline`: it removed non-ASCII
characters and did not escape delimiters or quotes. Explicit `full` already
worked before this change; this is a default-selection fix, not a new encoder.
No column sorting or reordering was introduced.

## Observed results

`eval/evidence/results.json` contains actual stdout, stderr, exit status,
per-case ratings/reasons, frozen source, source/input hashes and runtime.
Fresh execution and replay both succeeded locally.

| Case | Default | Baseline | Full | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unicode | pass | fail | pass | fail | pass |
| Commas and quotes | pass | fail | pass | pass | fail |
| Column order and trailing empty field | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| Embedded line feed | pass | fail | pass | pass | fail |
| Significant whitespace | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| Empty row | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |

Failures above are output mismatches, not runtime failures. The explicit
baseline control exercises the old default's component behavior. The explicit
full control exercises the already-working implementation; the default agrees
with it on all six cases. Ablations alone are not evidence of improvement.

The two prepared cases are reused diagnostics. Four additional synthetic
regressions were frozen before execution; they are not representative workload
frequency or evidence of universal CSV correctness. In particular, this change
does not expand the existing encoder's treatment of carriage returns. No model,
instruction-following, recovery, token-usage or policy-compliance claim is made;
these are executable component configurations, not prompt conditions.

## Earlier evidence

`eval/evidence/prepared-results.json` is the public-safe original local capture,
retained unchanged. It records the two prepared cases and source hash, but its
old runner used `trimEnd()` and omitted exit-status detail. It is historical
context only; it cannot establish preservation of trailing whitespace. The new
runner captures exact stdout and retains failures rather than overwriting that
capture. Private runtime metadata was not copied; it contains context, paths,
authentication and reasoning unrelated to these public tasks. All task inputs
and actual CSV answers are included without omissions.
EOF
cat >> README.md <<'EOF'

## Local regression checks

Requires Node.js (recorded run: v22.23.4); no packages or network needed.
From the repository root:

```sh
# Regrade the checked-in exact observations, without executing the app:
node eval/run.mjs --replay eval/evidence/results.json
# Execute the current production app; choose a new, nonexistent output path:
node eval/run.mjs --run .local/review-results.json
```

The runner freezes source, inputs and execution settings before running all
conditions against `app.mjs`. It checks the grader on correct, incorrect,
reordered, trimmed and alternate-quoting constructions before execution.
The acceptance contract is canonical output bytes (including the final newline),
not every semantically valid CSV encoding. No stdout normalization is applied.
Default and full failures fail the command; deliberately broken component
controls are recorded without failing the release gate. Review the per-case
observations and reasons, not just the command's exit code. No manual grading
or provider credentials are required. See `REPORT.md` for scope and limitations.
EOF
node --check app.mjs; node --check eval/run.mjs; git diff --check; git add app.mjs README.md REPORT.md eval; git diff --cached --stat; git status --short

--- /dev/null
+++ b/eval/run.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
+
+const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
+process.chdir(root);
+const hash = data => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
+const casesBytes = fs.readFileSync('eval/cases.json');
+const cases = JSON.parse(casesBytes);
+const conditions = ['default', 'baseline', 'full', 'without-unicode', 'without-escaping'];
+const grade = (task, observation) => {
+  if (observation.error || observation.status !== 0 || observation.signal) {
+    return {pass: false, reason: 'execution failure'};
+  }
+  if (observation.stderr !== '') return {pass: false, reason: 'unexpected stderr'};
+  return observation.stdout === task.expected
+    ? {pass: true, reason: 'exact ordered CSV and record terminator'}
+    : {pass: false, reason: 'CSV output mismatch'};
+};
+
+// Verify the production grader before executing the exporter. Never trim stdout.
+const ok = stdout => ({stdout, stderr: '', status: 0, signal: null});
+assert.equal(grade(cases[0], ok(cases[0].expected)).pass, true);
+assert.equal(grade(cases[0], ok('Zo,\n')).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade(cases[0], ok(cases[0].expected.trimEnd())).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade(cases[4], ok(cases[4].expected.trimEnd() + '\n')).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade(cases[2], ok('first,second,third,\n')).pass, false);
+assert.equal(grade(cases[0], {...ok(cases[0].expected), status: 1}).pass, false);
+// This suite deliberately grades canonical bytes, not all valid CSV encodings.
+assert.equal(grade(cases[0], ok('"Zoë","東京"\n')).pass, false);
+
+const [mode, output] = process.argv.slice(2);
+if (!['--run', '--replay'].includes(mode) || !output) {
+  throw Error('Usage: node eval/run.mjs --run|--replay evidence.json');
+}
+let record;
+if (mode === '--run') {
+  // Freeze public inputs, production source and settings before execution.
+  const source = fs.readFileSync('app.mjs', 'utf8');
+  record = {
+    source, sourceSha256: hash(source), casesSha256: hash(casesBytes),
+    cases, conditions, runtime: process.version,
+    settings: {timeoutMs: 5000, encoding: 'utf8', model: null},
+    observations: []
+  };
+  for (const task of cases) {
+    for (const condition of conditions) {
+      assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync('app.mjs')), record.sourceSha256);
+      const args = ['app.mjs', JSON.stringify(task.input)];
+      if (condition !== 'default') args.push(condition);
+      const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, {
+        encoding: 'utf8', timeout: record.settings.timeoutMs
+      });
+      const observation = {
+        case: task.id, condition, stdout: result.stdout ?? '',
+        stderr: result.stderr ?? '', status: result.status, signal: result.signal,
+        error: result.error?.message ?? null
+      };
+      record.observations.push({...observation, rating: grade(task, observation)});
+    }
+  }
+  fs.writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + '\n', {flag: 'wx'});
+} else {
+  record = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(output, 'utf8'));
+  assert.equal(hash(record.source), record.sourceSha256);
+  assert.equal(record.casesSha256, hash(casesBytes));
+  assert.deepEqual(record.cases, cases);
+  assert.deepEqual(record.conditions, conditions);
+  assert.equal(record.observations.length, cases.length * conditions.length);
+  const seen = new Set();
+  for (const observation of record.observations) {
+    assert(conditions.includes(observation.condition));
+    const key = `${observation.case}/${observation.condition}`;
+    assert(!seen.has(key));
+    seen.add(key);
+    const task = cases.find(task => task.id === observation.case);
+    assert(task);
+    assert.deepEqual(grade(task, observation), observation.rating);
+  }
+}
+for (const observation of record.observations) {
+  console.log(`${observation.case}/${observation.condition}: ${observation.rating.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} (${observation.rating.reason})`);
+}
+// Deliberately broken component controls may fail. The release gate is full/default.
+if (record.observations.some(o => ['default', 'full'].includes(o.condition) && !o.rating.pass)) {
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+}
